AITA for cutting my friend out after she tried to help me? | I (35 f) recently was put on the wrong medication and had a breakdown and had to be hospitalised for a night. The day I came out of hospital I went home to relax and was still very shaken up and exhausted. A friend of mine (36 f) contacted all my friends (even people she didn’t know well) and told them all to show up at my house at the same time unannounced to have me committed/sectioned in a mental health unit. She knows I have an absolute horrific fear of this and when we’ve spoken I’ve always said when I get depressed I just want love in my life and to be listened to, and I find that helps me more than a scary clinical environment that I can’t discharge myself from and may negatively affect my visa process, and health insurance I can’t afford. So all these people randomly show up at my door when I want to be left alone and are demanding they take me to a unit. Eventually I manage to make them leave but feel really unheard and unsafe. A few days later I felt better enough to leave the house and meet a guy friend in a bar. I wasn’t drinking alcohol. I didn’t realise this girl friend had set the location settings on my phone so she could track where I was. And I actually now think has been doing this for some time. Without me knowing she tracked where I was and sent another group text out to my friends telling them I was drunk in bars (I wasn’t) based on the roads she was tracking me walking down. A bunch of my friends texted me at once saying they were sick of me not helping myself because of this and detached from me. She also texted my colleagues and told them I have borderline personality disorder (I dont) and that it’s important they push me to be sectioned/committed to a mental health unit. I feel like even if I did have borderline personality disorder that should be a private thing that only I share with people? And also telling people I work with that I have (made up) mental illnesses could really harm my work. I dunno. She told me she’s the only person who cares about me and that’s why she’s the only one trying to help me. But I’m so upset with how it turned out that I cut her out of my life completely. AITA?

EDIT for those asking, my work found her message creepy and inappropriate and judged her and not me. They are of the opinion that they don’t care either way if I have a mental illness or not and I am so so lucky for how supportive and cool they’ve been.

EDIT to clarify another question ppl keep asking—3 years earlier I came out of a horrible relationship and was really low. I was new to the city and she was really only one of a few friends I had and she was around for all of that. Soon after I got well, started making loads of new friends, was doing brilliantly at work, going to therapy etc. but she kept telling me I wasn’t ok still. That I had bi polar (before she switched it up to borderline personality disorder), and that my therapist was wrong for me and I should see a psychiatrist of her choosing. Whenever I shrugged her off because I knew I was doing fine she would get really angry with me and tell me I was refusing her help because I had “done nothing for [myself] in three years.” Which really sucked because I felt like I had achieved so much. 

Thank you to everyone for the kind words. I really thought I was to blame and had ruined everything specially when I lost so many people. So it’s good to know this wasn’t my fault.

Aita for firing my mom | No doubt I'll leave important details out as this is something that has been ongoing for the last 8 years but I'll do my best.  

We had our first child and my mother, being retired, asked to be able to watch him.  It seemed like a great idea ..save money on daycare and it's someone we know...right?  
I was never fully convinced this was going to work out so before he was even born I switched to third shift so I could watch him during the day if needed. 

We had really only one request when she began watching him...come to our house.  Its a 10 minute drive and all his things are there.  This was okay for a month or 2.  She then began to request to take him places....this was out of our comfort zone and we were not ready for that.  As new parents if something were to happen like a wreck I'd rather it be me in the driver seat with my newborn than someone else.  I know accidents happen but I'd rather not forgive myself than not be able to forgive my mother.  

Well this is kind of where the problems started as my mother is not accustomed to being told no.  We were never against her going outside for walks or something we just didn't want her driving into the city or going to the mall...etc.  we got on several arguments over this over the next few months.  But she accepted our decision and never took him out.

At or around the 6 month mark we were having trouble with our son being able to sleep without being held.  We were both working parents and it was hard for myself and my wife to get household things done such as cooking, cleaning, laundry with a baby in our arms.  Realising that it was due to my mother holding him all day while she was watching him, I asked her to let him cry it out some.  I explained that it was causing us problems, but she didn't seem to care.  I explained it was nature over nurture and he will continue to cry if he knows that someone will pick him up and hold him.  Again she didn't care.  Basically she had a mommy knows best attitude and didn't care how it affected us.  

After a few weeks I told her we needed a break.  She didn't come over to watch him and i, while working night shift, watched him during the day.  I got him on a schedule and he was able to sleep on his own after a few weeks.  
She asked to watch him again and at this point said she would try her best to not hold him all the time.  

Fast forward a month, things are back to the way they were before.  He won't sleep on his own and we're having to hold him constantly and unable to do household chores.  
In a conversation one evening over the phone she admits that she has been lying to me over the last month and has been holding him all day.  

She always threatened us she would quit anytime we had a disagreement.  I told her her services were no longer required.  I watched our son during the day and my wife watched him during the evening when I slept and worked.  
Our relationship was never the same.  She didn't speak to me for around 2 years.  When she did she blamed my wife and my mother in law for all that happened.  She said the MiL was jealous she had to work and couldn't watch the baby and set these events in motion.  

Over the next several years we have gone off and on.  Basically my mother is able to put on a good face for a while but eventually says some rude comment insinuating were bad parents and instead of apologizing and moving on she doesn't show her face for a while.  To be clear she loathes my wife.  Which wasn't always the case, in fact she loved her before the fallout.

At the beginning of last year's school year my son's had a school dance and I picked them up.  At this point we hadn't spoken with my mother for about 6 months, but there she was volunteering at the school and putting on a good face. I had kept all of the stuff between my mother from my kids
...we never discussed it with them so they didn't know at the time what was going on, just spending some time with Grandma.  

I was furious that she found a way to bypass the parents and sneak into their lives.  I called her to discuss and she tells me she doesn't want to be around me or my wife just the kids....I tell her I'll be contacting the school to let them know she is not to be in contact with my kids.  (I never actually did this). 

I left out my mother is the kind of person that will twist a story and I don't want her giving her recollection of events to my kids....turning them against me.  I don't want my kids around a person that literally despises my wife and I and neither does my wife.  At the same time I hate my kids are missing out on time with their grandparents.  I should add my father basically just goes along with my mother.  So if she hates us he isn't allowed to come around.  How to let your kids drive off with a person that actively hates you?  

I get it this is loaded.  She was an abusive mother who didn't let us around our grandparents growing up.  She would flat out tell us they didn't want to see us even when I know that wasn't true.  I feel like this is history repeating itself.  (Minus the abuse)


Tldr:. Mother watched our son for us to replace childcare, didn't follow our requests, threatened to quit if she couldn't do it her way.  Told her she was no longer needed.  Rocky relationship last 8 years, weaseled her way into the school system to bypass us, the parents, because she didn't want to be around us.  Told her she was put on a list to not be in contact with our kids at school.

AITA for taking my older neighbors alcohol but kicking him out of the party. | Our family has a neighbour who's in his early 30's, I think. I just know he's grown. He was always staring, but when he found I was 19 (legal) he got way worse.

Since then, he's always flirting with me and my older sister. But not to the extent where we can say something about it. It's weird bc his age older, he isn't a hideous beast or anything so I'm not judging based on his appearance.

Whenever my friends are over, the creep is turned up by 100. He shamelessly flirts and always mentions that he models. He doesn't pick up on cues and refuses to let the small talk die. He's always asking what us "college girls" are up to, but in a really suggestive way. He's constantly staring at us. We hated it. Whenever HIS friends come over, they try to invite us over for drinks. Or worse, ask us if we want to see pictures from their photoshoot. We ALWAYS say no, I don't know why they think we're going to change our minds wtf. Idk why we're always polite, when we don't feel polite on the inside. But we don't know how to be "dominant" and assert ourselves with them. We can never find the words.

One by one, my friends stopped coming over because of him. He went from being a joke, to someone who caused a lot of unhappiness and discomfort.

I had party in my backyard. While I was inside,  someone says there's some old guys in my backyard. I step out and see it's my neighbour and his friends. I thought they were complaining about the music, but they brought alcohol. They came to my party, uninvited. I was so pissed off

I hear about old guys in my backyard. I step out and see it's my neighbour and his friends. I thought they were complaining about the music, but they brought alcohol. They came to my party, uninvited. I was so pissed off, that I cried.

They brought liqs, but everybody wanted them gone but the drinks to stay. They were flirting and making everybody uncomfortable. Because they're so much older. These whole grown men were flirting with the girls and couldn't even tell how repulsed everyone was. It killed the whole vibe.

My guy friends asked them to leave. They were talking about how the party just started and everybody's having a good time. My guy friend said that because they're here, nobody is having a good time. Told them to cut from the party and go buy his kids school supplies. They both looked embarrassed and left.

Before he left, he said it's wrong to use them for their alcohol. I said I don't want him there, and I don't want HIM. They tried to take the liqs, but I asked where they thought they taking them. They left it, but said something about being **ROBBED.**

I'm wondering if given the context, I was the asshole here. Was I wrong to make them leave the alcohol? Everyone there was happy that I kicked out the creeps and got them free beer. But I have that feeling where I did something wrong.
